comment: Reference hashes for fixture.epub, computed OFFLINE by the Python partial-MD5 reference from ~/Code/stump/MAC-MINI-DEPLOYMENT-PLAN.md — the implementation verified byte-for-byte against Stump's Rust koreader_hash values (13/13) for the real library, which CrossPoint's C++ then matched in production. Regenerate only by rebuilding the fixture and re-running that reference; never by copying the TS output back in.

text.comment: Word count for fixture.epub computed OFFLINE by scripts/gen_book_wordcount_reference.py — an independent implementation (Python html.parser + ElementTree) of what lib/books/epubText.ts does with regexes. This number is the denominator behind every page figure on the reading-stats page, so it gets a second source rather than being trusted. Regenerate only by rebuilding the fixture and re-running that script; never by copying the TS output back in.
text.caveat: This fixture has ONE spine document, so agreement here does not exercise spine ORDERING or the exclusion of manifest files outside the reading order. check:books:stats builds a second, multi-document epub in memory for that.
